AuditoryStimulus.description:
Auditory stimulus parameters common to all trials: every waveform of the set (src/sounds)
plays at levelDbfs, the lab's block (open_rigs.core.task StimulusSound).

levelDbfs.description: Each stimulus sound's level in dBFS RMS: the RMS of the sound over its whole length as the task gives it, before the speaker's equalisation, against full scale (a full-scale sine is -3). The lab's default -30. The workflow stops as the sound's buffer is built (at Go for a sound built once, at its trial for one built each trial) if any peak would reach -1 dBFS after equalisation. Sounds overlapping on a speaker share its headroom: each buffer's peak is checked, not their mix
levelDbfs.title: LevelDbfs

speakerLocations.description: Candidate lateral sound positions, one drawn per auditory trial, at least one on each side; no azimuth-0 entry: visual-only and neutral trials play from the centre. Each plays on rig.yml's nearest speaker
speakerLocations.title: SpeakerLocations

AuditoryStimulus.title: AuditoryStimulus

BackgroundNoise.description:
The background noise, one level for the experiment: looped on every speaker unequalised, faded in over 2 s once
the task file is read at Go (OpenRigs.Audio SpeakerMixer).

levelDbfs.description: The background noise's level in dBFS RMS: the RMS of the sound over its whole length as the task gives it, before the speaker's equalisation, against full scale (a full-scale sine is -3). The lab's default -50. The workflow stops as the sound's buffer is built (at Go for a sound built once, at its trial for one built each trial) if any peak would reach -1 dBFS after equalisation. Sounds overlapping on a speaker share its headroom: each buffer's peak is checked, not their mix
levelDbfs.title: LevelDbfs

BackgroundNoise.title: BackgroundNoise

OptogeneticsSettings.description:
Zapit optogenetic stimulation: the lab's block (open_rigs.core.task Optogenetics) and this task's laser timing;
laserDurationSeconds is a timed stimulus here, where coen-dome-navigation's laserMaxSeconds is a cap.

enabled.description: Whether this is an optogenetics experiment, Zapit running it: every trial sends it a condition from the conditions file (laser off at 0 mW on laser-off trials: the galvos move and the masking light shows), and the launching app checks Zapit is answering before Go
enabled.title: Enabled

zapitConditionsPath.description: Path to the Zapit conditions file loaded in Zapit. Its top-level stimLocations01, stimLocations02, ... entries are the conditions, numbered 1 to N with no gaps. The launching app keeps a copy beside the task file at Go
zapitConditionsPath.title: ZapitConditionsPath

laserPowerMw.description: Laser power on laser-on trials, in mW, the same for every condition: sent to Zapit with each StartStimulus (overriding the conditions file's power; Zapit's laser calibration turns it into volts) and logged as laserPowerMw (0 on laser-off trials). Required with optogenetics on
laserPowerMw.title: LaserPowerMw

laserOnProbability.description: Probability that a trial after trialsBeforeLaser is a laser-on trial, shared equally by every condition in the conditions file; all other trials are laser-off trials, sent a condition with the laser off
laserOnProbability.title: LaserOnProbability

laserToStimulusSeconds.description: Signed, in seconds: the trigger (the ZapitTrigger line) comes this long before the stimulus; 0 with it; negative after it. The trial's start is the end of the interval less the lead, max(this, 0), once the stage's quiet waits hold, and the stimulus comes the lead after the trial's start in every experiment, optogenetics on or off, so timing never reveals Zapit; the trigger only with optogenetics. Zapit is armed during the interval and adds no time. Refused above itiMinSeconds - 0.2 s (Zapit's reply margin); each task adds its own limits
laserToStimulusSeconds.title: LaserToStimulusSeconds

trialsBeforeLaser.description: Trials at the experiment's start with no laser-on trial among them (each still sends Zapit a condition, at 0 mW); laserOnProbability applies from the next trial
trialsBeforeLaser.title: TrialsBeforeLaser

laserDurationSeconds.description: How long the laser and the masking light stay on, in seconds from the trigger (a timed stimulus). With optogenetics on, at most responseDelaySeconds + itiMinSeconds - 0.7 s: Zapit is armed for the next trial only once this stimulus and its ramp-down (0.5 s at most) have ended, and its reply must be in 0.2 s before the next trigger
laserDurationSeconds.title: LaserDurationSeconds

noLaserOnRepeats.description: Whether repeat trials never have the laser on
noLaserOnRepeats.title: NoLaserOnRepeats

OptogeneticsSettings.title: OptogeneticsSettings

Penalty.description:
What a wrong or missed trial costs: a timeout, and the penalty sound with it (the trial log's penaltySoundOn and
penaltyTimeoutSeconds). Each task says which trials are penalised; timeoutSeconds has no lab default: each task file gives it.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout after a penalised trial, in seconds; the next interval starts after it
timeoutSeconds.title: TimeoutSeconds

sound.description: The penalty sound, with every timeout
sound.title: Sound

Penalty.title: Penalty

PenaltySound.description: The lab's penalty sound (OpenRigs.Audio PenaltySoundBuffer, the same in every task), on rig.yml's speakerArray.penaltySoundChannel alone, equalised for that speaker.

enabled.description: Whether the penalty sound plays with every timeout
enabled.title: Enabled

levelDbfs.description: The penalty sound's level in dBFS RMS: the RMS of the sound over its whole length as the task gives it, before the speaker's equalisation, against full scale (a full-scale sine is -3). The lab's default -30. The workflow stops as the sound's buffer is built (at Go for a sound built once, at its trial for one built each trial) if any peak would reach -1 dBFS after equalisation. Sounds overlapping on a speaker share its headroom: each buffer's peak is checked, not their mix
levelDbfs.title: LevelDbfs

PenaltySound.title: PenaltySound

RepeatRule.description: When a trial type is repeated: never, onFailure (after Incorrect or NoResponse) or onNoResponse (after NoResponse only).
RepeatRule.title: RepeatRule

maxRepeats.description: Maximum number of consecutive repeats of the same trial
maxRepeats.title: MaxRepeats

rulesPerType.description: Repeat rule per kind of trial with a right answer: localization visual, auditory, audiovisualCoherent; discriminationGoNoGo go, noGo; discriminationLeftRight left, right. The others never repeat
rulesPerType.title: RulesPerType

ResponseSettings.description: Lick-accumulation response rule; thresholdLicks 1 with degreesPerLick 0 is classic first-lick 2AFC.

thresholdLicks.description: Net lick difference (left minus right, absolute) that ends the response window with a choice; in discriminationGoNoGo, licks at the left spout (the right is not counted)
thresholdLicks.title: ThresholdLicks

degreesPerLick.description: Degrees the grating azimuth moves per net lick difference; 0 keeps the stimulus fixed
degreesPerLick.title: DegreesPerLick

ResponseSettings.title: ResponseSettings

RewardSettings.description: Reward delivery parameters; per-stage reward size lives in the training stage table.

largeRewardMultiplier.description: Reward size multiplier applied on large-reward trials
largeRewardMultiplier.title: LargeRewardMultiplier

largeRewardProbability.description: Probability that a trial is a large-reward trial
largeRewardProbability.title: LargeRewardProbability

RewardSettings.title: RewardSettings

SphericalPosition.description: A position on a sphere centred on the subject.

azimuth.description: Azimuth, in degrees. Zero is straight ahead, positive to the right.
azimuth.title: Azimuth

elevation.description: Elevation, in degrees. Zero is the horizontal plane.
elevation.title: Elevation

radius.description: Distance from the subject, in metres.
radius.title: Radius

SphericalPosition.title: SphericalPosition

TrainingStage.description: One row of the training stage table, chosen by the TrainingStage parameter; its quiet waits the lab's (open_rigs.core.task QuietWait).

lickQuietSeconds.description: Quiet wait: a trial's start needs this long with every spout released, in seconds, counted from the interval's start and restarted by every touch and release; a held contact (a paw or chin on a spout) holds the trial's start until released, so licks for the last reward cannot carry into the next trial; 0: off; at most 10 s. It lengthens the interval only when the mouse licks late in it (quietWaitSeconds)
lickQuietSeconds.title: LickQuietSeconds

wheelQuietSeconds.description: Quiet wait: a trial's start needs this long with the wheel still, in seconds, counted from the interval's start: the wheel's distance (forward and back added) over the last wheelQuietSeconds must stay within wheelQuietCm; 0: off (with wheelQuietCm 0); at most 10 s
wheelQuietSeconds.title: WheelQuietSeconds

wheelQuietCm.description: The most the wheel may move, forward and back added, within the last wheelQuietSeconds before the trial's start, in cm; 0: off (with wheelQuietSeconds 0); at most 20 cm
wheelQuietCm.title: WheelQuietCm

label.description: The stage's name, shown on Setup after its number
label.title: Label

trialWeights.description: This stage's own trial mix, keyed as the task's trialWeights, replacing it for this stage; null or left out: the task's trialWeights
trialWeights.title: TrialWeights

autoRewardProbability.description: Probability that a trial is an auto-reward trial: a miss on it is rewarded at the target spout, and is still a NoResponse for repeats
autoRewardProbability.title: AutoRewardProbability

bothSpoutsProbability.description: Probability that both spouts are presented rather than only the correct one
bothSpoutsProbability.title: BothSpoutsProbability

rewardSizeUl.description: Reward size, in microlitres; the valve's calibration plans the pulses. At most 20, the most one reward may ask for, with largeRewardMultiplier applied
rewardSizeUl.title: RewardSizeUl

contrasts.description: Candidate grating contrasts, each above 0, one drawn per trial that shows the grating
contrasts.title: Contrasts

allowRepeats.description: Whether failed trials may be repeated in this stage
allowRepeats.title: AllowRepeats

spoutMovements.description: Whether the spouts move during trials; false keeps them in (habituation): no withdrawal and no single-spout move for a reward
spoutMovements.title: SpoutMovements

TrainingStage.title: TrainingStage

TrialStructure.description: Timing of each trial, every wait on the Harp clock.

itiMinSeconds.description: Lower bound of the inter-trial interval, drawn uniformly for every trial, in seconds: from the last outcome (after any timeout; the first trial: the experiment folder's creation) to this trial's stimulus, drinkSeconds included. The stage's quiet waits can only lengthen it (quietWaitSeconds). At least drinkSeconds
itiMinSeconds.title: ItiMinSeconds

itiMaxSeconds.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn inter-trial interval, in seconds (itiMinSeconds)
itiMaxSeconds.title: ItiMaxSeconds

drinkSeconds.description: From the outcome (after any timeout) to drawing the spouts back, in seconds: time to drink a reward, inside the interval
drinkSeconds.title: DrinkSeconds

responseDelaySeconds.description: The response delay: from stimulus onset to the response window opening, in seconds; licks before it are not counted
responseDelaySeconds.title: ResponseDelaySeconds

responseWindowSeconds.description: The response window: how long it stays open, from responseDelaySeconds after stimulus onset, in seconds; with no choice by its end the trial is NoResponse
responseWindowSeconds.title: ResponseWindowSeconds

stimulusSeconds.description: How long the grating shows, in seconds from onset; at most responseDelaySeconds plus responseWindowSeconds, so it never outlasts the response window, and at most itiMinSeconds, so it is off before the next stimulus
stimulusSeconds.title: StimulusSeconds

stimulusToSpoutsInSeconds.description: From stimulus onset to moving the response spouts in, in seconds
stimulusToSpoutsInSeconds.title: StimulusToSpoutsInSeconds

TrialStructure.title: TrialStructure

TrialTypeRules.description:
The repeat rule of each kind of trial with a right answer, by trialWeights' keys: exactly the task type's (RULE_KEYS),
the others left out. The rest never repeat: localization's audiovisualConflict and neutral, every two-modality and neutral
trial in the discriminations (go/no-go's no-reward probes; left-right's random-reward probes). A key it lacks is refused, as Bonsai's
reader refuses it at Go.

audiovisualCoherent.description: localization only: grating and sound on the same side
audiovisualCoherent.title: AudiovisualCoherent

noGo.description: discriminationGoNoGo only: the other modality alone (NoGo)
noGo.title: NoGo

right.description: discriminationLeftRight only: the other modality alone
right.title: Right

TrialTypeRules.title: TrialTypeRules

TrialTypeWeights.description:
Relative draw weight of each kind of trial: exactly the task type's five keys (TRIAL_KEYS), the others left out.
localization: by what the trial shows. discriminationGoNoGo: go, noGo, audiovisualCoherent, audiovisualConflict, neutral.
discriminationLeftRight: left, right, audiovisualCoherent, audiovisualConflict, neutral.

audiovisualCoherent.description: Every task type: grating and sound on the same side
audiovisualCoherent.title: AudiovisualCoherent

audiovisualConflict.description: Every task type: grating and sound on opposite sides
audiovisualConflict.title: AudiovisualConflict

noGo.description: discriminationGoNoGo only: the other modality alone (NoGo)
noGo.title: NoGo

left.description: discriminationLeftRight only: leftModality alone (answered at the left spout)
left.title: Left

right.description: discriminationLeftRight only: the other modality alone (answered at the right spout)
right.title: Right

neutral.description: Every task type: grey screen, centre sound in localization, silent in the discriminations
neutral.title: Neutral

TrialTypeWeights.title: TrialTypeWeights

UclOpenCoenDomeDecisionMakingTaskLogic.description: Task logic definition for the coen-dome-decision-making experiment.
UclOpenCoenDomeDecisionMakingTaskLogic.title: UclOpenCoenDomeDecisionMakingTaskLogic

UclOpenCoenDomeDecisionMakingTaskParamet.description: Task parameters for the coen-dome-decision-making audiovisual tasks: localization and two modality discriminations.

rngSeed.description: Seed of the random number generator for these task parameters
rngSeed.title: RngSeed

taskType.description: localization: the answer is the side the stimulus came from, at that side's spout. discriminationGoNoGo: one spout (the left); lick on a goModality trial (Go), withhold on the other modality's (NoGo); a trial showing both modalities, or a neutral trial, is a probe, never rewarded or penalised. discriminationLeftRight: the left spout for leftModality, the right spout for the other; a trial showing both modalities, or a neutral trial, is a random-reward probe. In localization (audiovisualConflict, neutral) and discriminationLeftRight a random-reward probe moves both spouts in, and a coin drawn with the trial from the seeded stream decides a choice at either: heads rewarded at that spout, tails penalised as an incorrect choice; a miss as a scored trial's miss

goModality.description: discriminationGoNoGo only: the modality to lick for, shown on the stages' go trials; the other modality's (noGo) trials are NoGo
goModality.title: GoModality

leftModality.description: discriminationLeftRight only: the modality answered at the left spout, shown on the stages' left trials; the other (right) is answered at the right
leftModality.title: LeftModality

trialWeights.description: Relative draw weight per kind of trial, per mouse, on every stage that sets none of its own: each new trial draws one at random with these as relative chances, independently of every other trial (repeats copy the trial they repeat). localization by what the trial shows (visual, auditory, audiovisualCoherent, audiovisualConflict, neutral); discriminationGoNoGo by role (go, noGo, audiovisualCoherent, audiovisualConflict, neutral), discriminationLeftRight (left, right, audiovisualCoherent, audiovisualConflict, neutral), goModality or leftModality choosing the modality of go or left, the other modality's noGo or right
trialWeights.title: TrialWeights

backgroundNoise.description: The lab's background white noise (rig.yml's speakerArray.backgroundNoise) on every speaker, from Ready at the level of the task file as launched (open_rigs.core.task BackgroundNoise)

penalty.description: The timeout and penalty sound after an incorrect response or a miss (a miss on an auto-reward trial is rewarded instead), and on a random-reward probe after a choice on the coin's tails or a miss; in discriminationGoNoGo only after a lick on a NoGo trial (a Go miss and a no-reward probe have neither), open_rigs.core.task Penalty

trainingStages.description: Training stage table indexed by the TrainingStage parameter; a stage past the end stops the workflow at Go
trainingStages.title: TrainingStages

UclOpenCoenDomeDecisionMakingTaskParamet.title: UclOpenCoenDomeDecisionMakingTaskParameters

VisualStimulus.description: Grating stimulus parameters common to all trials; contrast is set per training stage.

azimuthMinDeg.description: Lower bound of the uniformly drawn grating azimuth, in degrees
azimuthMinDeg.title: AzimuthMinDeg

azimuthMaxDeg.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn grating azimuth, in degrees
azimuthMaxDeg.title: AzimuthMaxDeg

fixedAzimuthsDeg.description: Discrete grating azimuths, in degrees; when set and non-empty, every trial draws from this list (filtered to the trial's side, capped on coherent trials) instead of [azimuthMinDeg, azimuthMaxDeg]
fixedAzimuthsDeg.title: FixedAzimuthsDeg

elevationMinDeg.description: Lower bound of the uniformly drawn grating elevation, in degrees
elevationMinDeg.title: ElevationMinDeg

elevationMaxDeg.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn grating elevation, in degrees
elevationMaxDeg.title: ElevationMaxDeg

coherentAzimuthCapDeg.description: On coherent trials the grating azimuth magnitude is kept below this cap, in degrees
coherentAzimuthCapDeg.title: CoherentAzimuthCapDeg

gaussianWindowSigmaDeg.description: Sigma of the Gaussian aperture window, in degrees
gaussianWindowSigmaDeg.title: GaussianWindowSigmaDeg

orientationDeg.description: Grating stripe orientation, in degrees; drift direction is orthogonal to it (orientationDeg + 90 degrees)
orientationDeg.title: OrientationDeg

spatialFrequencyCpd.description: Grating spatial frequency, in cycles per degree
spatialFrequencyCpd.title: SpatialFrequencyCpd

temporalFrequencyHz.description: Unsigned grating drift rate, in Hz, drifting orthogonal to orientationDeg (orientationDeg + 90 degrees); 0 is static
temporalFrequencyHz.title: TemporalFrequencyHz

VisualStimulus.title: VisualStimulus
